display_name: Teach AI Create Or Update Prompt Request
explainer: Copyable request prompt for asking an AI to create or update a Tab 9 prompt-library asset safely.
how_it_works: The request tells the AI the target scope, forbidden actions, placement rules, metadata needs, and validation expectations.
risks: The AI may treat prompt-library work as source-code work.
mitigations: The request explicitly prohibits code changes unless a GUI/code gate is requested.
safe_usage: Paste this request into a chat when asking for a new Tab 9 prompt or prompt update.
example_usage: Replace <DESCRIBE_THE_PROMPT_TO_CREATE_OR_UPDATE> with the desired prompt task.
